i.norm:
Runs the shared parser test suite ({@link AbstractParserTestCase}) against the {@link PosixParser} implementation.

The only behaviour customised here is the parser instance used by the inherited tests; every other test case is provided by the superclass.
Wires the shared test fixture up with a {@link PosixParser} so that all inherited test cases exercise the POSIX-style parsing behaviour.

Disabled for {@link PosixParser}: parsing of negative-number options (for example {@code -42}) is not supported by this parser, as documented in CLI-184. The method body is intentionally empty because the test is skipped rather than executed.
